what: Review an owned item before pricing. Existing live listings remain managed on their selling site.

frame.who: A seller reviewing a captured draft or correcting saved inventory details.
frame.came_to: Check the photos and details, then save and choose an asking price.
frame.costly_mistake: Losing an edit, overwriting a newer version, or assuming saved details update a live listing.
frame.ways_out: Back with a discard prompt when edited; save into pricing for a draft or item detail for a live listing.
frame.in_the_loop: Only explicit Save writes the versioned owned item.

states.shows: Photos and labeled title, quantity, location and optional cost fields; one pinned save action.
Opening your item; no editable stale values.
Fetch retry, or save error with edits preserved. Version conflict offers reload.
An item without photos shows Photos are not available yet; an empty title must be filled before saving.

controls.on_tap: Validate fields and PATCH the owned item with its version; refresh inventory and open price for a draft or detail for a live listing.
Fetch the latest version and replace the form; a failed fetch shows an error instead of the old version.
